item.title: Green Signs SB 1234, Ordering New Review Of Hawaiian Electric’s Wildfire Plan
item.dc:creator: Jane Reporter
item.description:
Gov. Josh Green signed the measure Monday. The law requires a new review of utility wildfire plans.

The post Green Signs SB 1234 appeared first on Honolulu Civil Beat.
item.content:encoded:
Gov. Josh Green signed SB 1234 on Monday, ordering the Public Utilities Commission to review Hawaiian Electric Industries’ wildfire plan.

The commission opened Docket No. 2024-0123 last year. HECO said it would comply. Hawaiian Electric spokesperson Ann Doe said the company welcomed the review.

John Smith, a Kula resident, testified in support. Rep. Nadine K. Nakamura's committee heard the bill in March.
